text: Hey everybody, welcome to this week's

before we head to the track this

what I felt at the test in January. So,
I'm going to have to calm down here,
back up my corner entries, let the car
roll
center. You have to lift so much earlier

can work higher. If you get too high,

four, but it's really fun working this
